answer: Re-attestations are stored in ember and spiral lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 5 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the summit graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1121 impostors cost 642 times the honest price and take 28 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
